description.value:
You shape nearby junk into a minibot of 1st level or lower whose formula you used as this spell's locus. Activate the Minibot. If the locus is a handheld tech item, such as a comm unit, you can use it to install any electronic storage necessary for the minibot to function, such as songs in a beatbot or storage for a camerabot. When the spell ends, the minibot turns into a pile of junk

Heightened (3rd) You create a minibot up to 2nd level.

Heightened (4th) You create a minibot up to 4th level.

Heightened (5th) You create a minibot up to 8th level.

Heightened (6th) You create a minibot up to 12th level.

Heightened (7th) You create a minibot up to 14th level.

system.requirements: You have no other active minibots, and have the formula for a minibot installed in a tech item, used as a locus.
